properties.area_name: Meerganj
properties.source: Guria / Freedom Firm / Allahabad HC 2016-17 / Wikipedia
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via Guria conviction records + news
properties.story: UP's most documented red-light area. In 2015-17, NGO Guria's PIL led to 61 brothels being seized and 136 victims rescued from Meerganj; 41 traffickers later convicted to 10-14 years. The Allahabad High Court ordered the area shifted in 2016 after a social worker's petition, but most workers returned. Madrasi Gali, Satya Gali and Pahadi Gali are its known lanes.
properties.notes: District centroid only. No building-level pin.

properties.area_name: Shivdaspur (ex-Dalmandi)
properties.source: Wikipedia Shivdaspur + Guria Varanasi centre
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via Wikipedia + Guria centre reports
properties.story: Varanasi's red-light area since the 1970s, when Dalmandi near Kashi Vishwanath temple was closed and workers moved to this periphery settlement between Lahartara and Manduadih. Declining as customer numbers fall. NGO Guria runs an education centre here for children of sex workers - declared India's first 'child prostitution free' red-light area; a National Defence College delegation visited in 2018.
properties.notes: District centroid only.

properties.area_name: Kabadi Bazar
properties.source: Sage Journal 2455632720915320 + Sankalp NGO Meerut (1997)
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via academic photo-essay + NGO records
properties.story: A working junk-and-spice market in Meerut's old city where sex work has coexisted with trade for generations - documented in a 2020 Sage journal photo-essay. Activist Atul Sharma, who grew up nearby, has rescued hundreds of girls from these brothels since 1996. NGO Sankalp Shiksha Prasar Samiti has run a school for children of sex workers in this area since 1997.
properties.notes: District centroid only. Market area, not specific building.

properties.area_name: Natpurwa village
properties.source: Al Jazeera 2013 + The Hindu 2013 + Asha for Education Project 350
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via Al Jazeera + The Hindu features
properties.story: A village of ~5000 in Hardoi district, 70km from Lucknow, where the Nat community's women have practised hereditary sex work for ~400 years - a survival strategy after the British Criminal Tribes Act 1871 destroyed their traditional performer livelihood. Estimates suggest over 70% of women were involved at peak. Former worker Chandralekha now runs self-help groups here; Asha for Education funded a village school. Not a city brothel district - a documented case of community-based traditional practice.
properties.notes: Village centroid only. Sensitive - mapped at district level deliberately.

properties.area_name: Chawal wali gali + dispersed hotspots
properties.type: Dispersed hotspot - no single formal district
properties.reliability: high for Chawal wali gali, medium for dispersed
properties.source: SocialNews XYZ 2024 + Aazadi Foundation/UPNSW + CREATE India (UPSACS TI)
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via UPNSW union reporting
properties.story: Lucknow has no GB Road-style集中 brothel quarter. The old city's 'Chawal wali gali' is the historic core - lanes of intergenerational sex work that politicians never campaign in. Sex workers are otherwise dispersed near Charbagh station, Chowk, Hazratganj, Daliganj, Rajajipuram and Nishatganj. In 2024 workers formed the Uttar Pradesh Network of Sex Workers (UPNSW), officially recognised in June, to unionise and fight for dignity and schemes.
properties.notes: District centroid only. Dispersed street-based presence per UPNSW.

properties.area_name: Becon Ganj / Bada Bazaar
properties.source: Becon Ganj Wikipedia + Freedom Firm district list + local media
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via Freedom Firm rescue records
properties.story: Kanpur's historic red-light core sits in Becon Ganj and Bada Bazaar - among the oldest parts of the leather city, where several generations of sex workers have lived and worked. Anti-trafficking NGO Freedom Firm lists Kanpur Nagar among its active intervention districts; rescues of minors from these brothels are on record. Street-based solicitation also reported around Nayaganj and Kakadeo, though those are unverified commercial-directory claims.
properties.notes: District centroid only. Historic core verified; other zones unverified.

properties.area_name: Safedabad
properties.source: SocialNews XYZ election coverage 2024
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via election reporting
properties.story: A qasba in Barabanki district whose red-light area is locally known as a Samajwadi Party stronghold - one of the few recorded cases where sex workers' votes are courted but candidates refuse to campaign in person. Documented in May 2024 election coverage of UP's neglected red-light areas.
properties.notes: Town centroid only.

properties.area_name: Navabpura
properties.source: Freedom Firm Annual Report 2016-17 + KSS NGO TI
properties.last_verified: 2024-05 via Freedom Firm annual report
properties.story: Listed by anti-trafficking NGO Freedom Firm as one of its Uttar Pradesh raid/intervention sites in its 2016-17 annual report. Moradabad also hosts Kartik Shikshan Sansthan's UPSACS-funded Targeted Intervention working with FSWs and IDUs across several locations of the brass city.
properties.notes: Area centroid only.

properties.area_name: Nakhasa Bazar / Nakkasa Market
properties.source: High Court PIL Sunil Chaudhary 2019 + Amar Ujala + Live Hindustan survey order
properties.last_verified: 2019-06 via High Court order to SSP/DM Saharanpur
properties.story: Purana Shahar's main bazaar where the High Court, on advocate Sunil Chaudhary's PIL after Meerut Kabadi Bazar, ordered the district magistrate and SSP to survey and close the Nakhasa Bazar deh vyapar. The supplementary affidavit and rehabilitation officer's letter to Meerut-Saharapur mandate prove a long-standing kotha cluster in the old city.
properties.notes: Market centroid only. High Court-ordered closure, not specific building.

properties.area_name: Kashmiri Bazar / Basai village (22 kothas)
properties.type: Formal bazaar - historic core, now dispersed
properties.source: TOI 2015 21-girl rescue Kashmiri Bazaar + Jagran/InextLive 2019 raid 32 women + Agra Bharat analysis
properties.last_verified: 2019-08 via 32-women/11-customer police raid
properties.story: Agra's Mughal-era bazaar between Mal ka Bazar and Taj Ganj, where Nepali, Bedia, Bengali and Bangladeshi women worked from high balconies in 8x8 wooden cubicles. A 2015 Navi Mumbai police rescue recovered 21 girls sold for Rs2-3 lakh. In 2019 a joint raid found 32 women and 11 customers despite police records claiming closure. Now largely dispersed to hotels on Fatehabad Road and former village Basai.
properties.notes: Bazaar centroid only. 22 kothas historically.

properties.area_name: Madar Gate - Jeewan Gali / Sarai Kalan
properties.source: Live Hindustan 2023-09-02 Madar Gate + Outlook Hindi 2015 field
properties.last_verified: 2023-09 via field + historian Dr Vedvati Rathi
properties.story: Inside the old city's Madar Gate - built as Rangmahal for Raja Man Singh in 1804 - British-era mujra lanes Jeewan Wali Gali, Sarai Kalan and Tamoli Para remain active evenings. Historian Rathi traces its courtesan history to 1787 Sindhia era. A 2015 Outlook walk found rates Rs100-300 and 'viraasat maa se' narratives persisting alongside hardware shops.
properties.notes: Gate-mohalla centroid only.

properties.area_name: Badnaam Gali - 42 houses
properties.source: Jagran 2025-02 Firozabad brothel sealed residents migrate
properties.last_verified: 2025-02 via seal after hostage complaint
properties.story: 42-house gali sealed in Feb 2015 after a girl's hostage complaint led to 7 houses sealed and 20 locked as residents migrated to Mumbai. With 200+ voters missing during the SIR survey, locals now petition to rename the lane.
properties.notes: Gali centroid only. 42 houses reported.

properties.area_name: Basuka / Basureka Tawaif village
properties.source: Bhaskar DB Original 2023 Ghazipur tawaif village
properties.last_verified: 2023-03 via village field 50-60 houses
properties.story: A 15,000-population village near Ghazipur with 50-60 houses of women engaged in naach-gaana as livelihood - similar to Hardoi's Natpurwa. Mixed Nat-Muslim and Bhumihar community, termed 'meetthka gaon', with 50+ police cases linked to disputes over the practice.
properties.notes: Village centroid only. Community-sanctioned, not a city kotha.

properties.area_name: Wazirbag / Wazirganj Mohalla
properties.source: Bhaskar Digital 2026-05-04 + Bhaskar 2026 raid
properties.last_verified: 2026-05 via Kotwali Nagar ITPA 3/4/5/6 raid
properties.story: Kotwali Nagar mohalla where a house of Raghunath Prasad was raided; 3 arrested under ITPA 3/4/5/6, Rs3400 and objectionable material seized. Locals had locked the house from outside after long-running complaints.
properties.notes: Mohalla centroid only. Dispersed, not classic 20+ kotha cluster.

properties.area_name: NH-28 Madapar - Zero Point (Lucknow Bypass)
properties.type: Highway hotel belt - dispersed, not classic RLA
properties.source: Dynamite News Hindi 2025-07-14 + Bhaskar MLA Sarvan Nishad letter + Jagran Fly-In Hotel seal
properties.last_verified: 2025-07 via Gram Pradhan protest + MLA letter to DM/SSP
properties.story: Not a historic bazaar but a newly labelled 'red light area built' - a 2-dozen hotel/dhaba strip on the Lucknow bypass from Madapar to Zero Point near AIIMS. Villagers' panchayat and BJP MLA Sarvan Nishad's letter to the Commissioner allege open trafficking of minors in these hotels - leading to repeated seals like Hotel Fly-In, Krishna Inn and Sai Grand.
properties.notes: Highway-belt centroid only. Modern dispersed pattern, tagged as claimed red light area.

properties.area_name: Satellite - Bisalpur Chauraha street + BakarGanj
properties.source: Live Hindustan 2018 Satellite-Bisalpur + Live Hindustan 2026 BakarGanj Rs500-1000/hr WhatsApp bust
properties.last_verified: 2026-03 via BakarGanj ITPA house raid
properties.story: No historic kotha cluster like Meerut. Instead Bareilly's evening street trade from Satellite bus stand to Bisalpur Chauraha (kinnar/girls on buses) and WhatsApp-booked houses in BakarGanj (Rs500-1000/hr). Reflects UP's shift from bazaar kothas to dispersed street/hotel pattern.
properties.notes: Street-hotel centroid only. Dispersed pattern, not 50+ kotha bazaar.

properties.area_name: Pachenda Road OYO / Mahavir Chowk spa
properties.source: Bhaskar + Dynamite Jan 2026 Pachenda Road 5 couples + minor caught
properties.last_verified: 2026-01 via Pachenda Road OYO raid
properties.story: Muzaffarnagar has no Wikipedia-listed bazaar kotha. Pattern is NH-58 and Pachenda Road OYOs (Rose Inn) and Mahavir Chowk spas raided with couples and a minor. Highway motel belt, not a historic bazaar.
properties.notes: Hotel-belt centroid only. Modern dispersed.

properties.area_name: Kaushambi Sarovar Portico / Vaishali Sec-4 / Kala Patthar
properties.source: Jagran Aug 2025/ Feb 2026 Kaushambi 11 women + Zee Aug 2025 Vaishali 23 women + TOI 2016 Kala Patthar underpass
properties.last_verified: 2026-02 via Kaushambi hotel drug + sex raid
properties.story: NCR spillover, not a classic bazaar. Kaushambi Sarovar Portico Hotel (11 women + drugs), Vaishali Sec-4 commercial complex 3rd floor (23 women), and Kala Patthar underpass open-air brothel near Gaur Green City (Indrapuram). All TOI/Jagran/Zee documented.
properties.notes: NCR hotel/complex belt centroid only.

properties.area_name: Yamuna Expressway Raya Cut / Krishna Nagar spa
properties.source: TOI Aug 2025 spa 15 rescued + Zee Aug 2026 Yamuna Expressway 6 girls 13 youth
properties.last_verified: 2025-08 via two spa centres sealed
properties.story: Mathura's modern pattern mirrors Agra's dispersal: Krishna Nagar Blossom/Heaven spas in city and Yamuna Expressway Raya Cut hotels (Royal, New Sawariya Guest House) raided with 6 girls and 13 youth. Also Chhata Kotwali dhabas on highway.
properties.notes: Highway-spa belt centroid only.

properties.area_name: Khir Gali Rani Sati Guest House (Fatehganj)
properties.source: Jagran Apr 2026 guest-house license cancelled after 2025 raid
properties.last_verified: 2026-04 via license cancellation after 11-women raid 500m from chowki
properties.story: Guest house 500m from Fatehganj Chowki raided 19 Sep 2025, 11 women rescued, licence cancelled and premises sealed. Residents said the house had run for years. Part of Ayodhya's spa/guest-house dispersal.
properties.notes: Guest-house lane centroid only.

properties.area_name: Purani Basti Station Road 3rd floor
properties.source: ABP Live Jun 2026 Basti 5 women 11 men + Patrika Jan 2026 14 women 4 spas
properties.last_verified: 2026-06 via Station Road 3rd floor AHTU raid
properties.story: Purani Basti's Station Road 3rd floor building (Malviya Road/Roadways axis) raided with 5 women 11 men, plus a January AHTU sweep of 4 spas netting 14 women. Also GC Palace Badharkhurd and Madhwapur toll plaza houses.
properties.notes: Station-road building centroid only.

properties.area_name: Radha Family Restaurant, Maharajganj Road Kaptanganj
properties.source: NewsTrack Dec 2025 Azamgarh 9 arrested IGRS complaint
properties.last_verified: 2025-12 via Radha Family Restaurant IGRS-triggered raid
properties.story: Maharajganj Road restaurant raided after an IGRS online complaint: 5 men, 4 women, Rs1980 and condoms seized; owner Sarvesh Kumar Maurya held. Example of the restaurant-lodge dispersal replacing any single bazaar.
properties.notes: Restaurant centroid only.

properties.area_name: Hotel near Roadways / Sahadatpura
properties.source: TOI May 28 2023 Mau-Jaunpur hotel clampdown 14 women 16 men
properties.last_verified: 2023-05 via repeat raid Dec 31 2022 + May 2023 same hotel
properties.story: Roadways/Sahadatpura-area hotels in Mau raided twice (Dec 2022 and May 2023) with 14 women 16 men. Pattern mirrors neighbouring Jaunpur and Ghazipur - small hotels near the bus stand.
properties.notes: Bus-stand hotel centroid only.

properties.area_name: Olandganj hotel (Dharmapur road)
properties.source: TOI May 2023 same Mau-Jaunpur operation 6 women 2 men
properties.last_verified: 2023-05 via Olandganj hotel Rs500/room raid
properties.story: Olandganj hotel in Jaunpur city, run by a Dharmapur (Mau) owner, raided with 6 women and manager Mahesh Yadav; Rs500 per room was the rate, a woman procurer fled. Paired with the Mau raids that week.
properties.notes: Hotel centroid only.
